ابتذلتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلْتُنَّ (ibtaḏaltunna) /ib.ta.ðal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اُبْتُذِلْتُنَّ (ubtuḏiltunna) /ub.tu.ðil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
